page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes, no headings. Running head centred at the top. Page number at the top left. Catchword "maxime" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: populi repudiata est. Atq;(ut ad me re-dicā)[?] meministis Q.Maximo fratre Scipionis & L.Micino cōsulibus, q;popu-laris lex de sacerdotiis C. Licinii Crassi videbatur: cooptatio enim collegiorū ad populi beneficiū trāsferebatur. Atq; is primo instituit versibus agere cū populo. Tamē illius vendibile orationem religio deorū immortaliū, nobis defen-dentibus, facile vincebat. Atq; id actū est prætore me, quinquennio ante, q; cōsul sum factus. Itaq; re magis, q; authoritate causa illa defensa est. Quod si in scena, id est, in concione in qua rebus fictis, & adūbratis loci plurimum est: tamen verū valet, si modò id patefactum, & il-lustratum est: qd in amicitia fieri oportet, q; tota veritate ppenditur, in qua nisi, (ut dicitur) apertum pectus videas, tuūq; ostēdas, nihil fidum, nihil explo-ratum habeas ne amare quidem, aut a-mari possis, cum id q; vere fiat, ignores. Quanq; ista assentatio, quis pniciosa[?] sit, nocere tamen nemini potest, nisi ei, q; ea recipit, atq; ea delectatur. Itaq; fit, ut iy[?] assentatoribus suis aures patefaciat

page.notes: Page number read as 118 from the top left; the figure is faint. "dicā)" after "re-": the letters are faint, marked [?]. "pniciosa" in the line beginning "Quanq;" is not clearly legible; the word may be a printer's form of "pernitiosa", but I did not read it that way, so it is marked [?]. "iy" before "assentatoribus" is doubtful and marked [?]. "sacerdotiis" is read from a faint initial that could be an f; the long s is plain s. Abbreviations and spellings (tuūq;, ostēdas, Q.Maximo, cōsulibus) are kept as printed.
